replies.author: Zintenka
replies.body:
It's not a bug, probably an error in the XML

    <teams>
        <team id="purple" color="purple" min="10" max="25" max-overfill="35">Junr Empire</team>
        <team id="orange" color="orange" min="10" max="25" max-overfill="35">Zin Egalitarian</team>
    </teams>

It's the fact that there needs to be an obscenely high minimum player count for maps... It's a map-sided thing not a server side bug.
